column1: # CrowdStrike — Customer Contracts, Leases & Legal Summary
# Source: SEC EDGAR — XBRL companyfacts (10-K, as reported) + cited 10-K text. USD unless noted.
# Customer contract structure: subscription agreements with terms of one to three years; most billed annually in advance. Revenue recognized ratably over the subscription term.
# Master agreements include standard indemnification provisions for IP and breach.
# Lease agreements: real-estate operating leases; total lease cost ~$40.1M in FY2026.
# Debt indenture: $750.0M 3.00% Senior Notes due February 2029 (governed by an indenture with customary covenants).
# Credit agreement: Amended & Restated Credit Agreement (originated April 2019, Silicon Valley Bank); the revolving facility expired in January 2026.
# Litigation: subject to claims arising from the July 19, 2024 channel-file incident (shareholder and customer matters disclosed as contingencies).
